page.content:
Katara and Sokka's home at the South Pole.

How Southern Water Tribe connects

  • Faction: Water Tribes — The South is one of the Water Tribes.
  • Faction: The Gaang — The Gaang first gathers at the Southern Water Tribe.

What is Southern Water Tribe?

The Southern Water Tribe is the snow village Aang first meets after the iceberg, stripped of waterbenders by Fire Nation raids.

Key threads lead to Water Tribes and The Gaang.
